I hear you, and I appreciate you sharing what you've heard from friends and researchers. But I'm not going to change my view just because it's unpopular with the people around you.

The net positive argument usually focuses on connection and access to information, which are real. I just weigh the costs differently — the business model is built on capturing attention and amplifying outrage, and the mental health and civic data we have now is hard to ignore for me.

If everyone you talk to agrees, that might say more about who you're talking to than about the issue itself.
